items.title: The Stealth AI Stocks Are Dragging Down the Dow Again
items.summary: Caterpillar and Goldman Sachs are two of the biggest stocks in the Dow.  The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 50 points, or 0.1%, on a day when 22 of its 30 members were actually rising.  Chip stocks were getting hammered after a big run, fitting into a pattern of two-way volatility that’s characterized the group’s moves all year.

items.title: DIVO or JEPI: Which Monthly Dividend Actually Protects Your Principal?
